task_description: Predict whether a B2B SaaS customer will churn within the next 30 days, scored daily at midnight UTC.
intended_use: Trigger proactive customer success interventions for accounts with churn probability >= 0.35. Not intended for automated account termination or pricing decisions.

features.name: days_since_last_login
features.description: Days elapsed since the account last had any user login, as of snapshot_date

features.name: active_seats_last_30d
features.description: Number of distinct user seats with at least one session in the prior 30-day window

features.name: support_tickets_open
features.description: Count of unresolved support tickets at snapshot time

features.name: mrr_usd
features.description: Monthly recurring revenue in USD at snapshot time

features.name: contract_months_remaining
features.description: Months left on current contract term at snapshot_date

features.name: nps_score_last
features.description: Most recent NPS survey score (-100 to 100); null if no survey in last 90d

features.name: feature_adoption_pct
features.description: Fraction of paid feature modules with at least one event in the last 30d

features.name: account_age_days
features.description: Days since account creation at snapshot_date

features.name: api_calls_last_7d
features.description: Total API calls originating from the account in the 7-day window ending at snapshot_date

features.name: billing_overdue_flag
features.description: 1 if any invoice is past due at snapshot_date, else 0

features.name: cs_health_score
features.description: Composite customer success health score (0-100) set by CS team, updated weekly

features.name: rollup_logins_prev_quarter
features.description: Total login events in the calendar quarter prior to snapshot_date

features.name: export_events_last_30d
features.description: Number of data-export events (CSV/API bulk) in the 30-day window; elevated counts may signal offboarding

features.name: integrations_active_count
features.description: Number of third-party integrations in a connected state at snapshot_date

limitations: Model performance degrades for accounts with fewer than 60 days of history — flag these as low-confidence predictions.
NPS score is missing for ~38% of accounts; the model imputes median; predictions for this segment are less reliable.
Trained only on B2B SaaS accounts; not validated for B2C or marketplace customers.
Seasonal effects (e.g., end-of-year budget cycles) are partially captured but not explicitly modelled.
Model does not account for macroeconomic shocks or sudden product outages that would shift baseline churn rates.
ethical_considerations: Churn scores must not be used to deprioritize support for accounts predicted to churn — this creates a self-fulfilling prophecy.
Score distributions should be audited quarterly across industry_vertical to detect disparate false-positive rates.
CS interventions triggered by this model must be logged for feedback collection and bias monitoring.
Do not surface raw probability scores to customers; communicate only through internal tooling.
